brief.meaningEn: Feel excluded from a group, activity or shared experience.
brief.meaningZh: 覺得自己被排除在群體、活動或共同經歷之外。
brief.grammar: feel left out; felt in the past; left out derives from leave someone out.
brief.register: Neutral everyday feeling expression.
brief.boundaryZh: 感到被排除不證明其他人故意排斥，也不同於進度追不上別人的 feel left behind。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可能是意外漏訊息或不懂共同話題；要釐清情況而非直接判斷動機。
brief.outcomeZh: 能表達被排除的感受，並提出理解或邀請參與的方法。

listening.en: I felt left out when everyone discussed a trip I had not heard about, though the missing message may have been an accident.
listening.zh: 大家談論一個我沒聽過的旅行時，我感到被排除，但漏掉訊息可能只是意外。

options.en: They felt excluded but did not know whether it was intentional.
options.zh: 他們感到被排除，但不知道是否故意。

options.en: They proved everyone deliberately disliked them.
options.zh: 他們證明每個人故意討厭自己。

options.en: They were only worried about slower academic progress.
options.zh: 他們只是擔心學業進度較慢。

options.en: They knew every trip detail and felt fully involved.
options.zh: 他們知道旅行每個細節，感到完全參與。

listening.explanationZh: 感受明確，動機未確定；不是學業進度的落後。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：剛才大家聊天，你為甚麼那麼安靜？
reply.promptEn: Why were you so quiet while everyone was chatting?

options.en: I did not know about the plan they were discussing.
options.zh: 我不知道他們正在討論的計劃。

options.en: I felt left out because I had missed the invitation.
options.zh: 我漏了邀請，所以感到被排除在外。

options.en: I was unsure how to join a conversation about something unfamiliar.
options.zh: 話題不熟悉，我不知怎樣加入。

options.en: I wanted someone to explain what had been arranged.
options.zh: 我希望有人解釋已安排了甚麼。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都能說明沉默原因；金句只表達感受，不指控他人意圖。

scene.promptZh: 同學都在談一個沒有邀請你的聚會，你感到自己沒有參與，但不知道是不是有人漏寄通知。哪句最準確？

options.en: I feel left out, but I need to ask what happened.
options.zh: 我感到被排除，但需要問清楚經過。

options.en: I know for certain that every person wanted to hurt me.
options.zh: 我肯定每個人都想傷害我。

options.en: I only feel behind because classmates finished their homework first.
options.zh: 我只是因同學先完成功課而感到進度落後。

scene.explanationZh: 保留社交上的感受與資訊不足，沒有把它誤作進度比較。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不像 feel left out？

options.en: Someone feels excluded from a shared plan.
options.zh: 某人覺得被排除在共同計劃之外。

options.en: A newcomer feels unable to join an unfamiliar group conversation.
options.zh: 新人覺得無法加入不熟悉的群體對話。

options.en: A member is fully included and describes no sense of exclusion.
options.zh: 組員充分參與，也沒有描述被排除感。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有被排除的感受，便不符合。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我沒收到邀請，一定是大家討厭我。」哪句最體貼？

options.en: It makes sense to feel left out. Shall we check whether the message reached you before deciding why?
options.zh: 感到被排除是可以理解的。我們先看看訊息有沒有送到，再判斷原因，好嗎？

options.en: Treat the missing invitation as a reason to withdraw before asking whether the message was sent.
options.zh: 未問訊息是否已寄出，就因漏掉邀請而退出。

options.en: Explain that an accidental omission means there is no need to discuss the hurt feeling.
options.zh: 把意外遺漏解釋成沒有需要談受傷感受。

dialogue.explanationZh: 應接納被排除的感受，也查問訊息是否送達；既不先判斷動機，也不因可能意外就否定感受。

speaking.en: I felt left out until someone explained the plan and invited me to join.
speaking.zh: 有人解釋計劃並邀請我加入之前，我感到被排除在外。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再表達未能參與的感受。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你是新組員，大家談舊活動笑話時你聽不懂，感到無法參與。用一至兩句英文表達感受，並請人解釋。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說清未能參與的感受及具體需要，不必推斷大家故意排斥，也不與進度落後混淆。

examples.en: I feel left out because I do not know the old stories. Could someone explain the joke?
examples.zh: 我不知道舊故事，所以感到被排除。可以有人解釋笑話嗎？

examples.en: I felt left out during the conversation, but asking about the earlier activities may help me join in.
examples.zh: 談話期間我感到被排除，但詢問以前活動可能幫我參與。

takeaways.en: A newcomer may feel left out when shared references are not explained.
takeaways.zh: 共同典故沒被解釋時，新人可能感到被排除。

takeaways.en: I felt left out, so I asked how I could join the activity.
takeaways.zh: 我感到被排除，所以問可以怎樣參與活動。

brief.meaningEn: Feel accepted as part of a group or social setting.
brief.meaningZh: 在群體或社交環境中獲接納，感到融入。
brief.grammar: fit in (with a group); fitting in; past fitted in or fit in depending on variety.
brief.register: Common neutral social expression; distinguish physical fit.
brief.boundaryZh: 融入不要求所有人品味一樣，也不一定要隱藏自己；接受與盲從不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不立即融入不代表沒有價值；群體也可以主動歡迎不同成員。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述逐漸被接納，並區分融入與完全一樣。

listening.en: I began to fit in when the club welcomed my different ideas instead of asking me to copy everyone else.
listening.zh: 學會歡迎我的不同想法，而不是要求我模仿所有人後，我開始融入。

options.en: Being accepted while still having different ideas.
options.zh: 有不同想法仍得到接納。

options.en: Hiding every personal interest permanently.
options.zh: 永久隱藏每項個人興趣。

options.en: Making every member think exactly alike.
options.zh: 令每位組員想法完全相同。

options.en: Avoiding every conversation until the club changed its activities.
options.zh: 避開每次對話，直到學會改活動。

listening.explanationZh: welcome different ideas 表示接受差異，而非完全模仿或物件尺寸。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：新社團現在感覺怎樣？
reply.promptEn: How does the new club feel now?

options.en: I am starting to know people and feel comfortable joining in.
options.zh: 我開始認識大家，也放心參與。

options.en: I am beginning to fit in with the group.
options.zh: 我開始融入小組。

options.en: They listen to my ideas even when they differ from theirs.
options.zh: 即使想法不同，他們仍聽我說。

options.en: The regular activities have helped me feel more welcome.
options.zh: 定期活動讓我更感到受歡迎。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都描述接納與舒適感增加；金句不表示失去個人差異。

scene.promptZh: 你加入合唱團，起初陌生，大家之後會邀請你練習、也聽取你的建議，你漸漸有歸屬感。哪句合適？

options.en: I am starting to fit in.
options.zh: 我開始融入。

options.en: I must abandon every different opinion to be accepted.
options.zh: 我必須放棄每個不同意見才會被接納。

options.en: My role is only to copy everyone without contributing.
options.zh: 我的角色只是模仿每個人，不作貢獻。

scene.explanationZh: 互邀練習及聆聽想法顯示接納，不是單向模仿。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論最不宜由 fit in 得出？

options.en: Someone feels accepted in a group.
options.zh: 某人感到在群體中獲接納。

options.en: Someone must have exactly the same interests and opinions as every member.
options.zh: 某人必須與每位組員有完全相同興趣及意見。

options.en: A social setting begins to feel more comfortable.
options.zh: 社交環境開始令人較自在。

contrast.explanationZh: 融入不代表所有人完全一樣。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我要融入，就不能再提不同想法吧？」哪句最合適？

options.en: You can fit in and still have your own views. A welcoming group makes room for differences.
options.zh: 你可以融入，同時保留自己觀點。友善群體會容納差異。

options.en: Keep your different ideas to yourself until the group has accepted you.
options.zh: 等群體接納你後，才提出不同想法。

options.en: Judge whether you belong mainly by how closely your opinions match the group’s.
options.zh: 主要按意見與群體多相似，來判斷是否融入。

dialogue.explanationZh: 融入可保留不同觀點；先隱藏想法或只比相同程度，都把歸屬混同盲從。

speaking.en: I found it easier to fit in when people invited me to share my ideas.
speaking.zh: 大家邀請我分享想法後，我發現較容易融入。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明甚麼有助融入。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新同學擔心自己興趣不同就不能融入，你想邀請他參加活動並保留自己的想法。用一至兩句英文鼓勵。
writing.selfCheckZh: 鼓勵實際參與並接納差異，不要求放棄自我或保證立即有歸屬感。

examples.en: You can fit in without sharing every interest. Join our activity and tell us what you enjoy.
examples.zh: 你不用每項興趣都相同，也可以融入。參加我們活動，告訴我們你喜歡甚麼吧。

examples.en: It may take time to fit in, but your different ideas are welcome here.
examples.zh: 融入可能需要時間，但這裏歡迎你的不同想法。

takeaways.en: You can fit in without copying everyone else.
takeaways.zh: 你不用模仿所有人也可以融入。

takeaways.en: A welcoming group helps newcomers fit in gradually.
takeaways.zh: 友善群體幫助新人逐漸融入。

brief.meaningEn: Gradually weaken or reduce something through repeated small effects; confidence, stereotypes or resources can be eroded.
brief.meaningZh: 透過反覆的小影響逐漸削弱或減少某事物，例如信心、刻板印象或資源。
brief.grammar: chip away at + object; chip away at someone’s confidence / stereotypes / savings; chipped, chipping; at stays before the object. The outcome depends on what is being weakened or reduced.
brief.register: Vivid gradual-erosion metaphor within a phrasal verb.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是逐漸累積，不是一次突然變化，也不表示已完全消失；削弱信心可有害，削弱刻板印象可有益，資源則可逐步減少。
brief.misconceptionZh: 小評語反覆出現也可能有影響，但一次建設性意見不一定削弱信心。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述小影響累積造成的削弱或消耗，分清逐漸、突然及完全失去。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 不同受詞可呈現不同結果：信心可受損，刻板印象可逐步淡化，資源可逐步減少。本課練習主要示範信心的累積影響。

listening.en: The repeated comparisons chipped away at her confidence until she stopped volunteering answers.
listening.zh: 反覆比較逐漸削弱她的信心，直到她不再主動回答。

options.en: It weakened gradually through repeated comparisons.
options.zh: 它因反覆比較而逐漸削弱。

options.en: It increased after every comparison.
options.zh: 它每次比較後都增加。

options.en: A single unexpected event was the only cause described.
options.zh: 只描述了一次突如其來事件作原因。

options.en: The sentence proves she had no ability to answer.
options.zh: 句子證明她沒有回答能力。

listening.explanationZh: repeated 及停止主動回答連結累積影響，不是能力判定。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你擔心那些每天都有的小批評？
reply.promptEn: Why are you worried about those small criticisms that happen every day?

options.en: Small comments can build up over time.
options.zh: 小評語可以隨時間累積。

options.en: They may chip away at her confidence.
options.zh: 它們可能逐漸削弱她的信心。

options.en: She is becoming less willing to share her ideas.
options.zh: 她越來越不願分享想法。

options.en: The pattern seems to be discouraging rather than helping her.
options.zh: 這種模式看來在令她氣餒，而非幫助。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都指出累積影響；金句不把每項批評都當作傷害。

scene.promptZh: 組員每次提意見都被嘲笑，幾星期後由積極變得不敢開口。哪句合適？

options.en: The repeated ridicule chipped away at his confidence.
options.zh: 反覆嘲笑逐漸削弱他的信心。

options.en: The pattern proves he never had any useful ideas.
options.zh: 這種模式證明他從沒有用想法。

options.en: His confidence grew steadily because of the ridicule.
options.zh: 他的信心因嘲笑而持續增加。

scene.explanationZh: 反覆發生及幾星期後改變是逐漸削弱的證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 chip away at their confidence？

options.en: Repeated dismissive remarks make them increasingly hesitant.
options.zh: 反覆輕視評語令他們越來越猶豫。

options.en: Months of unfair comparison gradually reduce their willingness to try.
options.zh: 數月不公平比較逐漸減少他們嘗試意願。

options.en: One clear, supportive suggestion helps them feel more capable, with no weakening described.
options.zh: 一次清楚支持性的建議令他們覺得更有能力，沒有描述削弱。

contrast.explanationZh: 支持性建議令能力感提升，沒有累積削弱；反覆輕視評語或長期不公平比較則可能逐漸削弱信心。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「每次只是一句話，不可能有影響吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Repeated comments can chip away at their confidence even if each one seems small.
options.zh: 即使每句看來小，反覆評語仍可能逐漸削弱他們信心。

options.en: Assess each remark separately and leave the repeated pattern out of the discussion.
options.zh: 分開評估每句話，不談反覆模式。

options.en: Treat supportive advice and repeated ridicule as the same kind of feedback when judging the effect.
options.zh: 判斷影響時，把支持性建議與反覆嘲笑當作同類回饋。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需看反覆模式的累積影響，也分清回饋性質；不是只看單句或把所有建議視為相同。

speaking.en: Constant comparison can chip away at my confidence.
speaking.zh: 不斷比較可能逐漸削弱我的信心。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述反覆比較的累積影響。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友每次練習都被拿來跟高手比較，開始不敢嘗試。用一至兩句英文描述累積影響，並建議關注自己的小進步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用反覆及漸變支持片語，提出有助學習的回饋；不要把信心低當作沒有能力。

examples.en: The constant comparisons are chipping away at her confidence. We should notice her own small improvements.
examples.zh: 不斷比較正在逐漸削弱她信心。我們應留意她自己的小進步。

examples.en: Repeated criticism can chip away at her confidence, so feedback should include clear and supportive next steps.
examples.zh: 反覆批評可能逐漸削弱她信心，所以回饋應包括清楚而支持性的下一步。

glossary.zh: 清楚而支持性的下一步

takeaways.en: The small dismissive comments chipped away at my confidence over time.
takeaways.zh: 隨時間過去，那些輕視的小評語逐漸削弱我的信心。

brief.meaningEn: Treated as a loved and included member of the household, including a pet or close non-relative.
brief.meaningZh: 被當作受愛護、被接納的家庭一員，包括寵物或親近的非親屬。

brief.misconceptionZh: 叫寵物家人不等於只享受陪伴、不需照顧；沒有這個稱呼也不證明人不關愛。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用實際照顧與接納描述如家人的關係。

listening.en: Our old cat is part of the family; we include her needs when we plan trips and care for her every day.
listening.zh: 老貓是我們家庭一員；計劃旅行時我們會考慮牠需要，也每天照顧牠。

options.en: As a loved household member whose needs are considered.
options.zh: 當作受愛護、需要被考慮的家庭一員。

options.en: As an occasional visitor with no daily care.
options.zh: 當作偶爾來訪、沒有日常照顧的訪客。

options.en: With care limited to ordinary days, while her needs are left out of travel plans.
options.zh: 照顧只限平常日子，旅行計劃卻不考慮牠需要。

options.en: As someone with exactly the same physical needs as a human.
options.zh: 當作身體需要與人完全相同的對象。

listening.explanationZh: 日常照顧及計劃時考慮需要支持如家人的接納，不表示物種需要相同。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：你為甚麼會替狗安排假期照顧？
reply.promptEn: Why do you arrange holiday care for your dog?

options.en: His daily needs do not disappear when we travel.
options.zh: 我們旅行時，牠的日常需要不會消失。

options.en: He is part of the family, so we plan his care too.
options.zh: 牠是家庭一員，所以我們也安排牠的照顧。

options.en: We want someone reliable to look after him.
options.zh: 我們想找可靠的人照顧牠。

options.en: Planning ahead helps us meet our responsibility to him.
options.zh: 提早安排幫我們履行對牠的責任。

options.en: The rabbit is treated as part of the family.
options.zh: 兔子被當作家庭一員對待。

options.en: The rabbit’s needs are ignored whenever plans change.
options.zh: 計劃改變時，兔子的需要都被忽略。

options.en: The rabbit receives occasional attention but is left out of plans for the new home.
options.zh: 兔子只偶爾得到關注，卻未被納入新居安排。

scene.explanationZh: 每天陪伴及搬家前安排空間，是持續接納的實際線索；不是忽略改變時的需要或只偶爾關注。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以單憑這項資料說 part of the family？

options.en: A pet is loved and included in long-term household planning.
options.zh: 寵物被愛護，也被納入家庭長期計劃。

options.en: A close friend is regularly welcomed and treated with family-like care.
options.zh: 親近朋友常受歡迎，得到如家人般關懷。

options.en: A visitor briefly admires a stranger’s pet once, with no further relationship described.
options.zh: 訪客只欣賞陌生人的寵物一次，沒有其他關係資料。

contrast.explanationZh: 短暫欣賞不足以證明長期接納與家人般關係。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「我把寵物當家人，所以只要愛牠，不用想日常照顧吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Being part of the family includes having its needs considered, not just receiving affection.
options.zh: 成為家庭一員包括需要被考慮，不只是得到感情。

options.en: Plan the enjoyable activities first and leave daily care arrangements until you have spare time.
options.zh: 先計劃有趣活動，有空時才安排日常照顧。

options.en: Use the family label as the explanation without checking what care the pet actually needs.
options.zh: 只用家人的稱呼作解釋，不查寵物實際需要甚麼照顧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 家人般接納應包含實際需要；稱呼與感情不能代替日常照顧安排。

speaking.en: Our dog has been part of the family since we adopted him.
speaking.zh: 收養狗狗後，牠一直是我們家庭一員。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述長期接納的關係。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你家收養的老狗需要固定散步及陪伴，搬家時你們也先考慮牠的需要。用一至兩句英文描述牠的地位與照顧。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用具體照顧與長期接納支持如家人的關係，不只用稱呼取代責任。

examples.en: Our dog is part of the family. We plan regular walks and consider his needs before moving.
examples.zh: 狗狗是我們家庭一員。我們安排定期散步，搬家前也考慮牠需要。

examples.en: He has become part of the family, so his daily care remains important when our plans change.
examples.zh: 牠已成為家庭一員，所以即使計劃改變，日常照顧仍重要。

takeaways.en: Our pet is part of the family, and we plan for her daily needs.
takeaways.zh: 寵物是家庭一員，我們會安排牠的日常需要。

takeaways.en: A close friend can feel like part of the family.
takeaways.zh: 親近朋友也可以感覺像家庭一員。

brief.meaningEn: Settle into a small curved position next to someone.
brief.meaningZh: 在某人旁邊安頓成蜷曲的小姿勢。
brief.grammar: curl up + beside + person; curled, curling; describes posture and location.
brief.register: Natural descriptive phrasal verb, often for a resting person or animal.
brief.boundaryZh: 描述蜷曲姿勢，不單是坐近，也不表示一定睡着；beside 指旁邊，不是除了。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不用把所有休息姿勢都叫 curl up，也不能單憑姿勢判斷確切情緒。
brief.outcomeZh: 能清楚描述休息姿勢及相對位置。

sources.sentence: The cat spent the evening curling up beside you on the sofa.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 20, table 2, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The puppy curled up beside me on the sofa, but stayed awake watching the room.
listening.zh: 小狗在梳化上我身旁蜷起身子，但仍醒着看房間。
listening.promptZh: 小狗的姿勢與狀態怎樣？

options.en: It settled into a curved position nearby without necessarily sleeping.
options.zh: 牠在旁邊蜷曲安坐，並不一定睡着。

options.en: It stood upright far away from the speaker.
options.zh: 牠直立在遠離說話者的位置。

options.en: It curled up beside the speaker and then fell asleep on the sofa.
options.zh: 牠在說話者身旁蜷起身子，之後在梳化上睡着。

options.en: It lay stretched out flat beside the speaker while watching the room.
options.zh: 牠伸直身體平躺在說話者旁邊，看着房間。

listening.explanationZh: curled up 描述姿勢，beside 描述位置，stayed awake 明確否定已睡。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：昨晚小貓在你閱讀時做甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What did the kitten do while you were reading last night?

options.en: She rested close to me on the sofa.
options.zh: 牠在梳化上靠近我休息。

options.en: She curled up beside me and watched quietly.
options.zh: 牠在我身旁蜷起身子，安靜地看。

options.en: She settled near my legs while I read.
options.zh: 我閱讀時，牠安坐在我腿旁。

options.en: She stayed nearby without making much noise.
options.zh: 牠留在附近，沒有發出太多聲音。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都可描述閱讀時的小貓；金句同時提供蜷曲姿勢及旁邊位置。

scene.promptZh: 小狗靠近你後，把身體蜷成小團，留在你旁邊休息。哪句最準確？

options.en: The puppy curled up beside me.
options.zh: 小狗在我身旁蜷起身子。

options.en: The puppy stood upright across the room.
options.zh: 小狗在房間另一邊直立。

options.en: The puppy ran outside before settling anywhere.
options.zh: 小狗未安頓下來就跑到外面。

scene.explanationZh: 蜷曲姿勢加旁邊位置同時出現，符合完整詞組。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個姿勢最不符合 curl up beside you？

options.en: An animal settles into a small curved shape next to you.
options.zh: 動物在你旁邊蜷成小團安坐。

options.en: A person draws their legs in and rests next to you.
options.zh: 一個人收起雙腿，在你旁邊休息。

options.en: An animal stands fully stretched upright on the far side of the room.
options.zh: 動物在房間遠端完全伸直站立。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有蜷曲，也不在身旁，與描述不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「牠蜷在身旁，就是一定睡着吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: It can curl up beside you and still stay awake; the phrase describes posture and position.
options.zh: 牠可以在你身旁蜷起身子而仍醒着；詞組描述姿勢與位置。

options.en: Record the animal as asleep from the curved posture alone.
options.zh: 單憑蜷曲姿勢就記作已睡着。

options.en: Focus only on how close the animal is, without checking whether its body is curled.
options.zh: 只看動物有多近，不查牠身體是否蜷曲。

dialogue.explanationZh: 完整詞組描述姿勢與位置；靠近不一定蜷曲，蜷曲也不一定睡着。

speaking.en: The cat curled up beside me while I read on the sofa.
speaking.zh: 我在梳化閱讀時，貓在我身旁蜷起身子。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述動作與位置。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：下雨的晚上，你坐在梳化閱讀，小狗靠過來蜷成一團，在旁邊安靜休息。用一至兩句英文描述畫面。
writing.selfCheckZh: 保留蜷曲姿勢及身旁位置，無需自行加上睡着或確切情緒。

examples.en: The puppy curled up beside me while I read on the sofa. He rested quietly during the rain.
examples.zh: 我在梳化閱讀時，小狗在我身旁蜷起身子。下雨時，牠安靜休息。

examples.en: As I opened my book, the puppy began curling up beside me and stayed there quietly.
examples.zh: 我打開書時，小狗開始在我身旁蜷起身子，並安靜留在那裏。

takeaways.en: The puppy likes to curl up beside me while I read.
takeaways.zh: 我閱讀時，小狗喜歡在我身旁蜷起身子。

takeaways.en: She curled up beside him but remained awake.
takeaways.zh: 牠在他身旁蜷起身子，但仍醒着。

brief.meaningEn: Make someone feel happier or more cheerful.
brief.meaningZh: 令某人感到更開心或心情好一些。
brief.grammar: lift + possessive + mood; lifted in the past; may/can allows variation in effect.
brief.register: Neutral everyday metaphor for a change in feeling.
brief.boundaryZh: 心情改善不保證問題全部解決，也不是對每人都有效；本課不是治療建議。
brief.misconceptionZh: 短暫輕鬆仍可有價值，不必變成完全沒有煩惱。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述一件事如何改善心情，並保留個別差異。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Book 1 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A short walk outside can lift your mood.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 20, table 2, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The friendly message lifted my mood, even though I still had a difficult task to finish.
listening.zh: 友善訊息令我心情好一些，儘管我仍要完成困難工作。

options.en: It improved the speaker’s feeling without removing the task.
options.zh: 它改善了說話者感受，卻沒有消除工作。

options.en: It changed the work arrangement so the difficult task was no longer assigned to the speaker.
options.zh: 它改變了工作安排，困難工作不再分配給說話者。

options.en: It guaranteed that no worries would return.
options.zh: 它保證不會再有煩惱。

options.en: It made the speaker feel worse.
options.zh: 它令說話者感覺更差。

listening.explanationZh: even though 保留問題仍在，lifted my mood 只說心情改善。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：忙了一天後，甚麼讓你感覺好一些？
reply.promptEn: What helped you feel better after the busy day?

options.en: A quiet conversation with a friend helped.
options.zh: 跟朋友安靜交談有幫助。

options.en: Seeing the garden lifted my mood.
options.zh: 看見花園令我心情好一些。

options.en: I enjoyed taking a little time away from the screen.
options.zh: 我享受離開螢幕一小段時間。

options.en: The thoughtful message made the evening feel warmer.
options.zh: 體貼訊息令晚上感覺更溫暖。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都可描述個人感受改善；金句不保證對所有人有效。

scene.promptZh: 你收到朋友鼓勵後，雖然報告仍未完成，但感覺較開心。哪句合適？

options.en: Her encouragement lifted my mood.
options.zh: 她的鼓勵令我心情好一些。

options.en: The report was reassigned to someone else, so I no longer had to finish it.
options.zh: 報告改派別人，所以我不用再完成。

options.en: The encouragement left my mood unchanged, even though the deadline moved.
options.zh: 限期雖改動，鼓勵卻沒有改變我的心情。

scene.explanationZh: 題目說感覺較開心，報告仍未完成；不是工作改派或心情未變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 lift your mood 得出？

options.en: Something makes you feel more cheerful.
options.zh: 某事令你較開心。

options.en: Every practical problem must have disappeared.
options.zh: 每個實際問題一定已消失。

options.en: Your feeling changes in a positive direction.
options.zh: 感受朝正面方向改變。

contrast.explanationZh: 心情好一些不是問題全解決的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你笑了，就是再沒有壓力吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: The conversation lifted my mood, but I still need help planning the work.
options.zh: 談話令我心情好一些，但我仍需要幫忙規劃工作。

options.en: Stop discussing the workload because the person looked happier during the conversation.
options.zh: 因對方聊天時看來較開心，就不再談工作量。

options.en: Wait for another cheerful conversation before helping to plan the remaining task.
options.zh: 等再有一次開心對話後，才協助安排餘下工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 心情改善未必解決實際工作問題；仍可需要及時的計劃協助。

speaking.en: The kind message lifted my mood after a difficult afternoon.
speaking.zh: 困難的下午過後，善意訊息令我心情好一些。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述心情的正面變化。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為小組工作感到疲累，朋友的一句肯定讓你開心些，但你仍要安排明天的工作。用一至兩句英文描述。
writing.selfCheckZh: 描述心情改善及仍有的實際需要，不把正面感受當作一切問題已解決。

examples.en: Her kind words lifted my mood. I still need to plan tomorrow’s tasks, but I feel more encouraged.
examples.zh: 她的善意說話令我心情好一些。我仍要規劃明天工作，但較感鼓舞。

examples.en: The message lifted my mood without solving every problem. A clear plan will help with the work ahead.
examples.zh: 訊息令我心情好一些，卻沒有解決每個問題。清楚計劃會幫助之後工作。

takeaways.en: A thoughtful gesture can lift your mood.
takeaways.zh: 體貼舉動可以令你心情好一些。

takeaways.en: The conversation lifted my mood, though the challenge remained.
takeaways.zh: 談話令我心情好一些，雖然挑戰仍在。

brief.meaningEn: Be extremely important or precious to someone.
brief.meaningZh: 對某人極其重要或珍貴。
brief.grammar: mean the world to + person; means, meant; often about relationships, support or a valued opportunity.
brief.register: Warm emphatic idiom; not a precise ranking.
brief.boundaryZh: 極其重要不代表唯一在乎的事，也不表示依靠對方處理一切。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能當成實際金錢價值或全球名氣，亦不需貶低其他重要關係。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然表達珍惜與感謝，而不誇大成唯一價值。

sources.sentence: A loyal companion can mean the world to people who live alone.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 20, table 2, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Your support meant the world to me when I was new, even though you thought it was only a small gesture.
listening.zh: 我剛來時，你的支持對我極其重要，儘管你以為只是小舉動。

options.en: It was personally very important despite seeming small.
options.zh: 雖然看來小，對他個人仍極其重要。

options.en: It mattered only because it completed one short practical task.
options.zh: 它重要，只因完成了一項短暫實際工作。

options.en: It made every other relationship unimportant.
options.zh: 它令所有其他關係不重要。

options.en: It was too small to matter.
options.zh: 它太小，所以不重要。

listening.explanationZh: meant the world 強調個人極珍惜，即使對方以為舉動小；不是只為短暫實際效果。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：那時我的幫忙真的有那麼重要嗎？
reply.promptEn: Did my help really matter that much to you then?

options.en: Yes, it helped me feel welcome when everything was unfamiliar.
options.zh: 有，它讓我在一切陌生時感到受歡迎。

options.en: It meant the world to me.
options.zh: 它對我極其重要。

options.en: I still remember how relieved I felt after we talked.
options.zh: 我仍記得談話後有多安心。

options.en: Your kindness gave me confidence to ask for help again.
options.zh: 你的善意給我信心再次求助。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都真誠表達幫助的重要性；金句強調珍惜。

scene.promptZh: 朋友遠道來看你的首次演出，你很珍惜這份支持，想真誠道謝。哪句最自然？

options.en: Your being here means the world to me.
options.zh: 你到場對我極其重要。

options.en: I value your visit mainly because it increases the audience count.
options.zh: 我重視你的到訪，主要因為增加觀眾人數。

options.en: Your support has no personal importance.
options.zh: 你的支持對我沒有個人重要性。

scene.explanationZh: 題目強調朋友遠道支持對自己的意義，並非只為增加觀眾人數。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最不符合 mean the world to people？

options.en: Be extremely valuable to them emotionally.
options.zh: 對他們在情感上極其珍貴。

options.en: Matter very deeply to them.
options.zh: 對他們有非常深的重要性。

options.en: Give an exact monetary price for their relationship.
options.zh: 給出關係的確切金錢價格。

contrast.explanationZh: 這是感情或個人重要性的強調，不是金錢估價。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你說家人對你極重要，就是不能有其他興趣？」哪句最準確？

options.en: They mean the world to me, but other parts of my life can matter too.
options.zh: 他們對我極其重要，但生活其他部分也可以重要。

options.en: Set aside your own interests before asking how they could fit alongside family time.
options.zh: 未問興趣如何配合家庭時間，就先擱下自己的興趣。

options.en: Compare your interests with your family as though only the higher-ranked one deserves time.
options.zh: 把興趣與家人作比較，彷彿只有排名較高的一項值得花時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 極珍惜家人可以與其他目標並存，不必先排除或只容許一項重要。

speaking.en: Your encouragement means the world to me.
speaking.zh: 你的鼓勵對我極其重要。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再真誠表達珍惜。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友在你初次主持活動時留下來支持，你很感激。用一至兩句英文說明這份支持的重要性及帶來的感受。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體支持及感受表達珍惜，不把強調語氣寫成排除所有其他關係或目標。

examples.en: Your support meant the world to me at my first event. Knowing you were there helped me feel less nervous.
examples.zh: 在首次活動，你的支持對我極其重要。知道你在場，讓我沒那麼緊張。

examples.en: Your encouragement means the world to me, and I am grateful that you made time to be there.
examples.zh: 你的鼓勵對我極其重要，我很感激你抽時間到場。

takeaways.en: A small gesture can mean the world to someone when they need support.
takeaways.zh: 有人需要支持時，小舉動也可以極其重要。

takeaways.en: Your patient help meant the world to me.
takeaways.zh: 你的耐心幫忙對我極其重要。

titleEn: bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life
titleZh: 為生活帶來溫暖與陪伴

target.pattern: \b(?:bring|brings|bringing|brought) warmth,? affection,? and companionship into everyday life\b

brief.meaningEn: Add emotional comfort, care and company to ordinary life.
brief.meaningZh: 為平常生活增添情感溫暖、關愛和陪伴。
brief.grammar: bring + qualities + into everyday life; brings, brought. Warmth is emotional rather than temperature.
brief.register: Descriptive figurative wording, not a fixed idiom; the three qualities remain distinct.
brief.boundaryZh: 溫暖是感情上的，不是物理溫度；陪伴有價值，也可同時有實際照顧責任。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是保證所有孤單或困難消失，也不表示只有寵物能提供這些感受。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以透明的 bring qualities into life 句式描述陪伴價值。

sources.expression: bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life
sources.sentence: Pets bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.

listening.en: Their weekly visits bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life, though daily responsibilities still remain.
listening.zh: 他們每週到訪，為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴，雖然日常責任仍在。

options.en: Emotional comfort and company without removing every responsibility.
options.zh: 情感上的安慰與陪伴，卻沒有消除每項責任。

options.en: Only practical arrangements are exchanged, with no emotional closeness described.
options.zh: 只交流實務安排，沒有描述情感親近。

options.en: The visits take place only at rare formal occasions rather than in ordinary weeks.
options.zh: 到訪只在少有的正式場合發生，而非平常每週。

options.en: Only the time of the visit changes, while the sense of company remains absent.
options.zh: 只有到訪時間改變，仍沒有陪伴感。

listening.explanationZh: warmth 與 affection、companionship 並列，指情感；though 保留責任仍在。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你珍惜每週跟鄰居的聚會？
reply.promptEn: Why do you value the weekly gathering with your neighbours?

options.en: We share stories and make time for one another.
options.zh: 我們分享故事，也為彼此留時間。

options.en: It brings warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.
options.zh: 這個聚會為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。

options.en: The friendly routine helps me feel connected.
options.zh: 友善的定期相聚令我感到連繫。

options.en: I enjoy the care and company without needing a special occasion.
options.zh: 不需要特別場合，我也享受關心與陪伴。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都解釋相聚價值；金句把情感上的三種好處放進日常生活。

scene.promptZh: 家人每天留時間聊天和互相關心，平凡日子也有親近感。哪句最貼切？

options.en: These moments bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.
options.zh: 這些時刻為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。

options.en: These moments are only for exchanging household schedules, without care or closeness.
options.zh: 這些時刻只用來交換家庭時間表，沒有關心或親近。

options.en: The family saves all its contact for special formal occasions instead of ordinary days.
options.zh: 家人把全部聯繫留到特別正式場合，而不是平常日子。

scene.explanationZh: 每天聊天與互相關心，支持平常日子的情感親近；不是純實務安排或只在正式場合接觸。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由本課表達得出？

options.en: Ordinary routines can include emotional closeness.
options.zh: 平凡日常可以包含情感親近。

options.en: Care and company can make daily life feel warmer.
options.zh: 關懷與陪伴可令日常生活感覺更溫暖。

options.en: Receiving companionship guarantees that all difficulties disappear.
options.zh: 得到陪伴保證所有困難消失。

contrast.explanationZh: 情感好處不等於全部困難被消除。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「寵物帶來溫暖，所以不用考慮照顧時間吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Pets can bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life, but their needs still require time and care.
options.zh: 寵物可為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴，但牠們需要仍要時間及照顧。

options.en: Choose the pet for its companionship first and work out the care time after bringing it home.
options.zh: 先因陪伴而選寵物，帶回家後才計算照顧時間。

options.en: Use the amount of care as a reason to leave the emotional value out of the discussion.
options.zh: 因需要照顧，就在討論中略過情感價值。

dialogue.explanationZh: 陪伴價值與照顧責任都要考慮；不應延後實際安排，也不必抹去情感價值。

speaking.en: Shared routines bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.
speaking.zh: 共同日常習慣為生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再以完整品質列舉描述日常好處。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你家開始每天留十分鐘聊天，大家會分享小事並互相關心，令平凡日子更親近。用一至兩句英文描述這個習慣的價值。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以日常關懷支持情感溫暖，不把 warmth 當溫度，也不保證所有問題消失；這是可理解的組合句式。

examples.en: Our short conversations bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life. We make space to listen and care.
examples.zh: 簡短談話為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。我們留空間聆聽及關心。

examples.en: Taking time for one another can bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life without needing a special event.
examples.zh: 不需要特別活動，為彼此留時間也可為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。

takeaways.en: Regular contact can bring warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.
takeaways.zh: 定期接觸可為日常生活帶來溫暖、關愛與陪伴。

takeaways.en: The visits brought warmth, affection, and companionship into everyday life.
takeaways.zh: 到訪為日常生活帶來了溫暖、關愛與陪伴。

brief.meaningEn: Remove the mess that an animal or person has left.
brief.meaningZh: 清理動物或人留下的髒亂。
brief.grammar: clean up after + person/animal; cleaned up after; after identifies whose mess, not only time sequence.
brief.register: Natural everyday multiword verb pattern.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是只把動物洗乾淨，也不只是某人離開之後做一般清潔；要有清理由其造成的髒亂。
brief.misconceptionZh: 照顧寵物包括日常清理，不只享受玩耍；本課不指定醫療或衛生程序。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述清理誰留下的髒亂及相關日常責任。

sources.sentence: Caring for a puppy includes cleaning up after it every day.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 20, table 2, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The puppy scattered food around the bowl, so I cleaned up after him before leaving.
listening.zh: 小狗把食物弄散在碗周圍，所以我離開前清理了牠留下的髒亂。

options.en: They removed the mess the puppy had made.
options.zh: 他們清理了小狗造成的髒亂。

options.en: They washed the puppy’s coat instead of clearing the floor.
options.zh: 他們沒有清地板，而是清洗小狗毛髮。

options.en: They cleaned an unrelated area after someone else fed the puppy, rather than removing the scattered food.
options.zh: 別人餵小狗後，他們清潔另一處地方，而非清理散落食物。

options.en: They caused the food to be scattered.
options.zh: 他們令食物散開。

listening.explanationZh: 食物散在碗周圍，cleaned up after him 指清理牠造成的髒亂。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：照顧新小狗除了玩耍還要做甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What does caring for the new puppy involve besides playing?

options.en: We need to keep its feeding area tidy.
options.zh: 我們需要保持牠的進食位置整潔。

options.en: We have to clean up after it every day.
options.zh: 我們每天都要清理牠留下的髒亂。

options.en: We should plan time for its daily care.
options.zh: 我們應預留日常照顧時間。

options.en: Everyone should agree who handles the practical tasks.
options.zh: 大家應同意由誰處理實際工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都提供照顧責任；金句明確說清理寵物造成的髒亂。

scene.promptZh: 貓把紙屑弄到地上，你收拾牠留下的紙屑。哪句最準確？

options.en: I cleaned up after her.
options.zh: 我清理了牠留下的髒亂。

options.en: I only watched her play without tidying anything.
options.zh: 我只看牠玩，沒有整理任何東西。

options.en: I washed her fur rather than clearing the paper.
options.zh: 我沒有清紙屑，而是洗牠的毛。

scene.explanationZh: 收拾貓造成的紙屑是 clean up after 的對象關係。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 clean up after it？

options.en: Remove spilled food that the pet scattered.
options.zh: 清理寵物弄散的食物。

options.en: Clear paper that the animal pulled onto the floor.
options.zh: 收拾動物拉到地上的紙。

options.en: Admire the pet and leave all its mess untouched.
options.zh: 只欣賞寵物，完全不處理牠留下的髒亂。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有任何清理動作，便不符合。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「after 就是之後，所以這句只說清潔時間？」哪句最準確？

options.en: In clean up after it, after identifies whose mess you remove, not just when you clean.
options.zh: 在 clean up after it 中，after 說明你清理誰留下的髒亂，不只是何時清潔。

options.en: Work out when the animal leaves before deciding whether after refers to its mess.
options.zh: 先算動物何時離開，再決定 after 是否指牠留下的髒亂。

options.en: Translate after as a time link and omit whose mess needs removing.
options.zh: 把 after 翻作時間連接，省去要清理誰留下的髒亂。

dialogue.explanationZh: clean up after someone/something 交代髒亂來源；只看時間會漏去片語關係。

speaking.en: I cleaned up after him when he scattered food around the bowl.
speaking.zh: 牠把食物弄散在碗周圍時，我清理了牠留下的髒亂。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述清理誰造成的髒亂。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家人想養小狗，你提醒大家每天要分擔牠留下的髒亂清理，並先約定誰負責。用一至兩句英文。
writing.selfCheckZh: 明確是清理寵物造成的髒亂，提出分工；不要誤寫成只洗寵物或一般時間順序。

examples.en: We will need to clean up after it, so we should agree on daily tasks before adopting the puppy.
examples.zh: 我們要清理牠留下的髒亂，所以收養小狗前應同意日常分工。

examples.en: Everyone should help clean up after it rather than leave all the practical work to one person.
examples.zh: 大家都應協助清理牠留下的髒亂，而不是把所有實務交給一人。

takeaways.en: Looking after a pet includes cleaning up after it.
takeaways.zh: 照顧寵物包括清理牠留下的髒亂。

takeaways.en: We shared the work of cleaning up after them.
takeaways.zh: 我們分擔清理牠們留下的髒亂的工作。

brief.meaningEn: Disorganised, inconsistent or unsettled; this lesson focuses on routines and plans.
brief.meaningZh: 混亂、不一致或沒有穩定規律；本課聚焦日常安排與計劃。
brief.grammar: a routine/schedule is all over the place; separate literal sense can mean scattered everywhere.
brief.register: Informal emphatic idiom.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是所有安排都失敗，也不必真的物件四散；要有不穩定、難預測的線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能由日程混亂推斷整個人沒能力，改變安排也不一定毫無計劃。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述日程缺乏規律，並提出恢復清楚安排的方法。

sources.sentence: My routine was all over the place before I adopted the dog.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 20, table 2, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: With meetings changing every day, my schedule was all over the place and I kept missing breaks.
listening.zh: 會議每天都改，我的日程混亂不定，不斷錯過休息。

options.en: It was inconsistent and difficult to manage.
options.zh: 它不穩定，難以管理。

options.en: It followed one predictable routine every day.
options.zh: 它每天都按可預測流程進行。

options.en: It proved the speaker could never organise anything.
options.zh: 它證明說話者永遠無法安排任何事。

options.en: It had no appointments of any kind.
options.zh: 它完全沒有任何約會。

listening.explanationZh: 每天改會議及錯過休息顯示混亂，不是永久能力判定。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你這星期難找時間見面？
reply.promptEn: Why is it difficult to find a time to meet you this week?

options.en: The meeting times keep changing.
options.zh: 開會時間不斷改。

options.en: My schedule is all over the place.
options.zh: 我的日程混亂不定。

options.en: I cannot yet tell which afternoons will stay free.
options.zh: 我還不能確定哪些下午會有空。

options.en: I am trying to reorganise the appointments before making another plan.
options.zh: 我正嘗試重新安排約會，再訂其他計劃。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都可解釋難約時間；金句概括不穩定安排。

scene.promptZh: 你的小組沒有共用日曆，時間反覆改，成員常收到不同安排。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The planning is all over the place.
options.zh: 計劃安排混亂不定。

options.en: The planning is clear and consistent for everyone.
options.zh: 計劃對大家都清楚一致。

options.en: The team recorded each change in one consistent shared calendar and everyone followed the same time.
options.zh: 團隊把每次改動記在同一共用日曆，大家依相同時間。

scene.explanationZh: 沒有共用日曆、反覆改時間及不同安排，支持混亂描述；不是已有單一一致版本供大家使用。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不像 all over the place 的日程意思？

options.en: Appointments change unpredictably and conflict with each other.
options.zh: 約會難以預測地改變，彼此衝突。

options.en: Tasks are listed clearly in a stable shared timetable.
options.zh: 任務在穩定共用時間表上清楚列出。

options.en: A routine lacks consistent times and regularly overlaps.
options.zh: 日常安排沒有固定時間，經常重疊。

contrast.explanationZh: 清楚穩定的安排與混亂不定相反。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「時間表亂，我一定做甚麼都不行。」哪句最有幫助？

options.en: The schedule is all over the place, but we can start with one clear calendar and update it together.
options.zh: 日程是混亂，但我們可先用一份清楚日曆，一起更新。

options.en: Assess your general ability from this week’s conflicting arrangements before trying a clearer calendar.
options.zh: 未試較清楚的行事曆，就憑這星期矛盾安排評估整體能力。

options.en: Keep using the separate message threads and wait for people to work out which time is current.
options.zh: 繼續用分開訊息串，等大家自己找出哪個時間最新。

dialogue.explanationZh: 安排混亂是可具體處理的問題；不應據此作全人判斷，也不宜讓矛盾訊息持續。

speaking.en: My routine was all over the place until I set regular times for the main tasks.
speaking.zh: 我為主要任務訂定固定時間前，日常安排一直混亂不定。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述規律建立前的安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你這星期的功課、練習與會議時間反覆衝突，想先做一份共用日曆。用一至兩句英文描述問題及下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以反覆衝突或不穩定支持混亂描述，提出日程修正，不把它當成永久能力差。

examples.en: My schedule is all over the place, so I need one clear calendar for homework, practice and meetings.
examples.zh: 我的日程混亂不定，所以需要一份清楚日曆，安排功課、練習及會議。

examples.en: Our plans are all over the place. Let us agree on regular times and keep the shared calendar updated.
examples.zh: 我們計劃混亂不定。我們同意固定時間，並持續更新共用日曆吧。

takeaways.en: The timetable was all over the place after several last-minute changes.
takeaways.zh: 幾次臨時改動後，時間表混亂不定。

takeaways.en: If the plan is all over the place, start by confirming one shared version.
takeaways.zh: 如果計劃混亂不定，先確認一份共用版本。

brief.meaningEn: A steadying source of routine or stability in everyday life.
brief.meaningZh: 在日常生活中提供規律或穩定感的支點。
brief.grammar: be/become/provide an anchor; an anchor in daily life / in uncertain times. The optional context identifies the setting; the count-noun image can stand alone when its steadying role is clear.
brief.register: A reflective stability metaphor, not a fixed requirement to use in daily life. Here the examples focus on familiar routines as a steadying point.
brief.boundaryZh: 穩定來源不保證所有問題消失，也不一定要依靠某一人；可以是規律或活動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有穩定支點不表示整天不能改變，更不必放棄彈性。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體日常規律解釋穩定感來源。

listening.en: The short morning routine became an anchor in daily life when the rest of my timetable kept changing.
listening.zh: 其他時間表不斷改變時，簡短早晨習慣成為日常生活中的穩定支點。

options.en: It offered a predictable point within a changing schedule.
options.zh: 它在多變日程中提供可預期的穩定點。

options.en: The morning routine changed as unpredictably as the rest of the timetable.
options.zh: 早晨習慣與時間表其他部分同樣難預測地改變。

options.en: The whole timetable became fixed rather than just one familiar point.
options.zh: 整個時間表都固定下來，而不只是一個熟悉支點。

options.en: Only the task duration became shorter, without any predictable routine being established.
options.zh: 只是工作時間縮短，沒有建立可預期習慣。

listening.explanationZh: 其他安排仍在變，這個習慣提供一個穩定來源，並非控制全部生活。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：日程那麼多改動，你怎樣保持一點穩定？
reply.promptEn: How do you keep some stability when your schedule changes so much?

options.en: I keep a short routine at the start of each day.
options.zh: 我每天開始時保留一個短習慣。

options.en: The morning walk is an anchor in daily life.
options.zh: 早晨散步是日常生活中的穩定支點。

options.en: A regular check-in helps me notice what needs attention.
options.zh: 定期自我檢視幫我留意需要處理的事。

options.en: I try to protect one familiar activity even when other plans move.
options.zh: 即使其他計劃改，我也嘗試保留一項熟悉活動。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都描述維持穩定的做法；金句比喻一個支點，不是全部控制。

scene.promptZh: 搬家後很多事陌生，但每天晚飯時與家人聊天，讓你有熟悉規律。哪句合適？

options.en: The evening conversation became an anchor in daily life.
options.zh: 晚間談話成為日常生活中的穩定支點。

options.en: The family conversation became as irregular as the unfamiliar arrangements around it.
options.zh: 家庭談話變得與周圍陌生安排同樣不定時。

options.en: The dinner became shorter, but the familiar family contact was no longer part of it.
options.zh: 晚飯較短，但不再有熟悉家庭交流。

scene.explanationZh: 每天晚飯聊天提供熟悉規律；不是談話不定時，也不是只縮短晚飯而沒有交流。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不像 an anchor in daily life？

options.en: A familiar activity provides a steady reference point.
options.zh: 熟悉活動提供穩定參照。

options.en: A predictable routine helps someone feel settled.
options.zh: 可預期習慣令人安定。

options.en: An arrangement changes unpredictably each day and offers no stability.
options.zh: 安排每天難以預測地改，沒有提供穩定。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有穩定來源便不符錨的比喻作用。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「穩定支點就表示其他安排都不能改吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: A routine can be an anchor in daily life while the rest of the day remains flexible.
options.zh: 一個習慣可成為日常生活穩定支點，同時其他日程仍有彈性。

options.en: Make the rest of the day follow the same fixed pattern before keeping this helpful routine.
options.zh: 先令整天其他部分都按相同固定模式，才保留這項有幫助的習慣。

options.en: Drop the steady routine whenever another part of the day needs adjusting.
options.zh: 當日其他部分一要調整，就放棄穩定習慣。

dialogue.explanationZh: 穩定支點與其他時間的彈性可以並存，不需把整天固定，也不必因局部變動就放棄支點。

speaking.en: A quiet morning ritual can be an anchor in daily life.
speaking.zh: 安靜早晨習慣可成為日常生活中的穩定支點。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述一個穩定來源。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你剛轉到新學校，日程有很多改變，但每天回家與家人喝茶聊天給你熟悉感。用一至兩句英文描述這個習慣的作用。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明具體習慣與穩定感的連結，同時容許其他安排改變，不保證所有問題解決。

examples.en: Our evening tea became an anchor in daily life. The familiar conversation helped me feel settled after school.
examples.zh: 晚間喝茶成為日常生活中的穩定支點。熟悉談話讓我放學後感到安定。

examples.en: A regular chat with my family is an anchor in daily life, even while my school timetable changes.
examples.zh: 即使學校時間表改變，與家人定期聊天仍是日常生活中的穩定支點。

takeaways.en: A simple routine can be an anchor in daily life.
takeaways.zh: 簡單習慣可成為日常生活中的穩定支點。

takeaways.en: The weekly gathering became an anchor in daily life during a period of change.
takeaways.zh: 變動期間，每週相聚成為日常生活中的穩定支點。

options.zh: 它增加另一項好處。

options.en: It contradicts the first statement.
options.zh: 它反駁前句。

options.zh: 它把安靜房間寫成參觀的下一站，而非額外好處。

listening.explanationZh: 兩個相關好處被相加，不是因果或時間次序。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你推薦這個社區課程？

options.en: It is practical and the timetable suits me.
options.zh: 它實用，時間表也適合我。

options.en: The teaching is clear. On top of that, we get useful practice.
options.zh: 教學清楚。除此之外，我們還有實用練習。

options.en: The teacher answers questions patiently.
options.zh: 老師耐心回答問題。

options.en: It gives beginners a chance to try the skills safely with guidance.
options.zh: 它讓初學者有機會在指導下安心嘗試技巧。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都提供推薦理由；金句自然加入額外好處。

scene.promptZh: 你已說活動免費，現在想再補充交通方便這項好處。哪句自然？

options.en: On top of that, the centre is easy to reach.
options.zh: 除此之外，中心也方便到達。

options.en: As a result of free entry, the centre is easy to reach.
options.zh: 免費入場的結果，是中心方便到達。

options.en: However, the centre is easy to reach.
options.zh: 然而，中心方便到達。

scene.explanationZh: 免費及交通方便是相加的好處；as a result 誤加因果，however 則誤加對比。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最不符合 on top of that？

options.zh: 它加入另一個相關重點。

options.en: It can add either a benefit or a problem.
options.zh: 它可增加好處或問題。

options.en: It always proves that the previous point caused the next one.
options.zh: 它永遠證明前一點造成下一點。

contrast.explanationZh: 補充不是因果證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這個片語只可以說更多麻煩吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: On top of that can add a benefit too, such as useful training as well as flexible hours.
options.zh: on top of that 也可加好處，例如彈性時間以外還有實用培訓。

options.en: Choose another complaint to follow the phrase, even though the next point is a benefit.
options.zh: 即使下一點是好處，也選另一項抱怨接在片語後。

options.en: Use the phrase to place the training later in time rather than add it as another benefit.
options.zh: 用片語把培訓放在時間上較後，而不是加入額外好處。

dialogue.explanationZh: on top of that 可追加好處或壞處，本身不表示事件在時間上較後。

speaking.en: The guide is clear. On top of that, it is available in several languages.
speaking.zh: 指南清楚。除此之外，還有多種語言版本。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再自然補充另一項好處。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你推薦一個圖書館工作坊，因為費用低，還可跟導師練習。用一至兩句英文先說一點，再補充另一點。
writing.selfCheckZh: 讓第二點是相關補充，不要把 on top of that 當作因此或只有負面才可用。

examples.en: The workshop is affordable. On top of that, we can practise with the tutor.
examples.zh: 工作坊費用負擔得起。除此之外，我們還可跟導師練習。

examples.en: The course offers clear explanations, and on top of that, beginners get plenty of guided practice.
examples.zh: 課程提供清楚講解，除此之外，初學者還有很多指導下練習。

takeaways.en: The room is spacious. On top of that, it has clear signs.

takeaways.en: The task is urgent. On top of that, two helpers are away.
takeaways.zh: 任務緊急。除此之外，兩名幫手又不在。

listening.en: Leading the trip is a responsibility we should not take lightly because several people depend on our planning.
listening.zh: 帶領旅行是我們不應輕率看待的責任，因為幾個人依靠我們的安排。
listening.promptZh: 說話者建議怎樣處理責任？

options.en: Treat it seriously and prepare for others’ needs.
options.zh: 認真對待，並準備照顧其他人需要。

options.en: Reject it immediately without considering the details.
options.zh: 不考慮細節便立即拒絕。

options.en: Ignore the planning because responsibility is easy.
options.zh: 因為責任輕鬆就忽略準備。

options.en: Assume that no other person will be affected.
options.zh: 假定不會影響其他人。

listening.explanationZh: should not take lightly 要求慎重準備，不一定拒絕。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你不立即答應帶整隊人去旅行？
reply.promptEn: Why do you not immediately agree to lead the whole group on the trip?

options.en: I need to understand what the role involves.
options.zh: 我需要了解這個角色涉及甚麼。

options.en: I should not take this responsibility lightly.
options.zh: 我不應輕率看待這項責任。

options.en: We must check the practical arrangements first.
options.zh: 我們必須先核對實際安排。

options.en: Other people’s needs require careful planning.
options.zh: 其他人的需要要求仔細計劃。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都解釋審慎考慮的原因；金句不是直接拒絕或恐慌。

scene.promptZh: 朋友想養寵物，卻未想過照顧時間和費用。哪句提醒最合適？

options.en: Pet ownership is not something to take lightly.
options.zh: 養寵物不是應輕率看待的事。

options.en: Agree to get the pet first and work out the care time and costs afterwards.
options.zh: 先答應養寵物，之後才計算照顧時間及費用。

options.en: Decline before finding out what care the animal would actually need.
options.zh: 未查動物實際需要甚麼照顧，就先拒絕。

scene.explanationZh: 提醒先了解時間與費用，才作慎重決定；未查便答應或拒絕都未回應責任。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最符合 take a promise lightly？

options.en: Consider carefully what is needed to keep it.
options.zh: 仔細考慮履行所需條件。

options.en: Make the promise without caring whether it can be kept.
options.zh: 不在乎能否履行便作承諾。

options.en: Ask for details before committing.
options.zh: 承諾前先問細節。

contrast.explanationZh: 不認真考慮能否履行才是輕率看待；注意這題問符合，而非不宜。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「你認真考慮，就是不肯幫忙吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: I am willing to consider it, but I do not want to take the commitment lightly.
options.zh: 我願意考慮，但不想輕率看待這份承諾。

options.en: Treat the questions about duties as a refusal before hearing the person’s decision.
options.zh: 未聽最終決定，就把詢問職責當作拒絕。

options.en: Agree to the role first and discuss what it requires only after accepting.
options.zh: 先答應角色，接受後才討論要求。

dialogue.explanationZh: 慎重查問可與願意幫忙並存；不應把它直接當拒絕，也不宜未了解就答應。

speaking.en: We should not take this responsibility lightly.

speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再提醒對責任保持認真。

examples.en: You should not take it lightly, because someone will depend on you. Ask about the routine before making a promise.
examples.zh: 你不應輕率看待，因為有人會依靠你。作承諾前先問日常安排。

takeaways.en: A promise is not something to take lightly.

takeaways.en: I did not want to take the role lightly, so I asked what it involved.
takeaways.zh: 我不想輕率看待這個角色，所以問它涉及甚麼。

options.en: The species faced a severe threat close to extinction.

options.en: The species had already disappeared completely.

options.en: The threat was described as a tiny harmless change.
options.zh: 威脅被描述為微小無害改變。

listening.explanationZh: 接近危機不是已滅絕，也沒有精確數字。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼個案強調要保護剩下的棲息地？
reply.promptEn: Why does the case study stress protecting the remaining habitat?

options.en: The remaining area supports a population already under severe threat.
options.zh: 剩餘範圍支持已受嚴重威脅的族群。

options.en: The species has been pushed to the edge of extinction.
options.zh: 物種已被推至滅絕邊緣。

options.en: Further habitat loss could make recovery harder.
options.zh: 進一步失去棲息地可能令恢復更難。

options.en: The report describes a serious situation, not an ordinary fluctuation.
options.zh: 報告描述嚴重情況，而不是一般波動。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都根據題設危機解釋保護需要；金句不表示已滅絕。

scene.promptZh: 假設一種動物只剩極小族群，主要棲息地又正在消失，面臨接近滅絕的危機。哪句合適？

options.en: The species is being pushed to the edge of extinction.
options.zh: 物種正被推至滅絕邊緣。

options.en: The species is already confirmed to have no surviving members.
options.zh: 物種已確認沒有任何存活個體。

options.en: The situation is a minor change with no serious danger.
options.zh: 情況只是沒有嚴重危險的小改變。

scene.explanationZh: 題設明確嚴重威脅，但仍有存活族群，不能說已完全消失。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以支持 pushed to the edge 的本課意思？

options.en: A tiny remaining population loses most of its habitat and faces extinction.
options.zh: 極小剩餘族群失去大部分棲息地，面臨滅絕。

options.en: A stable population shows a small normal fluctuation, with no serious threat described.
options.zh: 穩定族群有小幅正常波動，未描述嚴重威脅。

options.en: A case study describes a species brought close to disappearance.
options.zh: 個案描述一個接近消失的物種。

contrast.explanationZh: 強烈危急表達需要嚴重威脅，不能只靠普通小幅變動。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「接近滅絕，就是已經全部消失吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Being pushed to the edge of extinction means facing extreme danger, not necessarily being extinct already.
options.zh: 被推至滅絕邊緣表示面對極大危險，不一定已經滅絕。

options.en: Report the species as already extinct before checking whether any individuals remain.
options.zh: 未查是否仍有個體存活，就報作已滅絕。

options.en: Use the phrase to estimate the remaining population without consulting the figures.
options.zh: 未查數據，就用片語估算剩餘族群數量。

dialogue.explanationZh: 接近滅絕是高度危險，不是結果已完成，也不提供精確數量。

speaking.en: The species was pushed to the edge of extinction by the loss of its habitat.

listening.en: In the example, the woodland was torn apart by several new roads, leaving animals in isolated patches.
listening.zh: 在例子中，幾條新道路令林地被破壞分割，動物留在互相隔離的小片地區。

options.en: A continuous area became divided into disconnected patches.
options.zh: 連續地區被分成互相斷開的小片。

options.en: Every tree was necessarily removed from the whole region.
options.zh: 整個地區每棵樹必定被移走。

options.en: The roads improved every habitat connection.
options.zh: 道路改善了每項棲息地連結。

options.en: The sentence only describes criticism of a written report.
options.zh: 句子只描述對書面報告的批評。

listening.explanationZh: isolated patches 說明分割，不保證所有樹都消失，也不是批評作品。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼課堂地圖把幾條新道路標成問題？
reply.promptEn: Why does the classroom map mark the new roads as a problem?

options.en: They divide a previously connected habitat into small sections.
options.zh: 它們把原本連續的棲息地分成小部分。

options.en: The woodland is being torn apart, leaving isolated areas.
options.zh: 林地正被破壞分割，留下隔離地區。

options.en: The diagram shows fewer connections between the remaining patches.
options.zh: 圖示顯示剩餘小片之間連結減少。

options.en: Animals may find it harder to move between the areas.
options.zh: 動物可能較難在地區之間移動。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都按題設解釋空間碎裂；金句不要求所有土地消失。

scene.promptZh: 假設一片連續林地被大規模建設割成幾塊，動物無法像以往互通。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The habitat has been torn apart by development.
options.zh: 棲息地被建設破壞分割。

options.en: The habitat remains fully connected with no change.
options.zh: 棲息地完全連續，沒有改變。

options.en: The phrase means every animal is definitely extinct.
options.zh: 片語表示每種動物都肯定已滅絕。

scene.explanationZh: 分塊與連結中斷是本課意思，不自行推論所有動物滅絕。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最清楚使用本課「棲息地碎裂」，而非對作品嚴厲批評？

options.en: The reviewer tore the essay apart in her comments.
options.zh: 審閱者在評語中把文章批評得體無完膚。

options.en: The forest was torn apart into isolated patches.
options.zh: 森林被破壞分割成隔離小片。

options.en: The editors praised the report’s clear structure.
options.zh: 編輯稱讚報告清楚結構。

contrast.explanationZh: 森林被分割成隔離小片，指空間碎裂；審閱者嚴厲批評文章，則是 tear apart 的另一種批評義。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「被分割，就是整個森林已經完全不存在？」哪句最準確？

options.en: A forest can be torn apart while some patches remain; the issue is lost connection and serious damage.
options.zh: 森林可以被分割而仍剩部分；問題是連結流失及嚴重破壞。

options.en: Remove the surviving patches from the map before describing the fragmentation.
options.zh: 未描述碎裂前，就把仍存在的小片森林從地圖刪去。

options.en: Count the remaining trees but leave the broken connections out of the assessment.
options.zh: 只點算剩餘樹木，不把連結中斷納入評估。

dialogue.explanationZh: 仍有小片森林可與嚴重碎裂並存；需看失去的連結，不只看是否還有樹。

speaking.en: The woodland was torn apart into disconnected patches.
speaking.zh: 林地被破壞分割成互不連接的小片。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述棲息地碎裂。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：課堂案例中的林地被道路割成幾塊，仍有樹木，但動物移動困難。用一至兩句英文描述碎裂與仍存部分的分別。
writing.selfCheckZh: 描述實際分割及失去連結，不必說所有土地或動物消失；與105關係瓦解及作品批評義分開。

examples.en: The woodland has been torn apart into isolated patches. Some trees remain, but the connections have been lost.
examples.zh: 林地被破壞分割成隔離小片。仍有樹木，但連結已流失。

examples.en: The habitat was torn apart by the roads, making movement between the remaining areas more difficult.
examples.zh: 棲息地被道路破壞分割，令剩餘地區之間移動更困難。

takeaways.en: The habitat was torn apart by several roads.
takeaways.zh: 棲息地被幾條道路破壞分割。

takeaways.en: A woodland can be torn apart even when some trees remain.
takeaways.zh: 即使仍有樹木，林地也可能被破壞分割。

target.pattern: \bfight(?:s|ing)? a losing battle\b|\bfought a losing battle\b

brief.meaningEn: Struggle against a problem when success is unlikely under the current conditions.
brief.meaningZh: 在目前條件下難有勝算，仍努力對抗問題。
brief.grammar: fight a losing battle against/with + problem; fighting, fought.
brief.register: Vivid conversational idiom; state the conditions rather than declare permanent impossibility.
brief.boundaryZh: 很難成功不等於永遠零機會；改變方法或條件可能改善結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是只因工作困難就一定輸，也不必是真正戰爭。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述努力與持續阻力不相稱，並提出改變條件的方法。

sources.sentence: Without protection, conservationists may be fighting a losing battle.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 21, table 2, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: We were fighting a losing battle against the clutter while new boxes arrived faster than we could sort them.
listening.zh: 新箱子來得比我們整理更快時，我們對抗雜物堆積的努力難有勝算。
listening.promptZh: 為甚麼目前整理方法難有成效？

options.en: The incoming work exceeded what they could handle.
options.zh: 新來工作量超過他們能處理的量。

options.en: The group had already solved every storage problem.
options.zh: 小組已解決每個儲物問題。

options.en: The idiom proves no possible change could ever help.
options.zh: 成語證明任何改變都永遠無用。

options.en: There was no work or resistance to deal with.
options.zh: 沒有工作或阻力需要處理。

listening.explanationZh: 箱子到得更快是目前阻力，不表示所有改善都不可能。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼你想先停止收新箱，而不是只叫大家整理快一點？
reply.promptEn: Why stop accepting new boxes rather than just ask everyone to sort faster?

options.en: The rate of incoming boxes is the main problem.
options.zh: 新箱到來的速度是主要問題。

options.en: We are fighting a losing battle if the pile grows faster than we can clear it.
options.zh: 如果堆積比清理快，我們便是在難有勝算下苦撐。

options.en: Changing the intake would give us a chance to catch up.
options.zh: 改變接收量才會讓我們有機會追上。

options.en: The team needs a manageable flow of work.
options.zh: 團隊需要能應付的工作流量。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都指向目前條件與根源，而非只要求更努力。

scene.promptZh: 小組每天刪垃圾電郵，但垃圾郵件篩選尚未啟用，新訊息來得比清理速度快，積壓越來越多。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They are fighting a losing battle until they address the source.
options.zh: 處理源頭前，他們一直在難有勝算下苦撐。

options.en: Their current approach has already stopped all new messages.
options.zh: 現有方法已停止所有新訊息。

options.en: Because the task is hard, every possible solution must fail.
options.zh: 因為任務難，每個可能方案都必須失敗。

scene.explanationZh: 篩選未啟用而新訊息持續來得較快，支持目前清理方法難有勝算；仍可透過改變條件處理。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以支持 fight a losing battle？

options.en: A problem grows faster than the current method can reduce it.
options.zh: 問題增長比現有方法減少的速度快。

options.en: Repeated efforts leave the same unchecked cause in place.
options.zh: 反覆努力仍保留未處理的相同原因。

options.en: A difficult task makes steady progress using adequate support.
options.zh: 困難任務在足夠支援下穩定進展。

contrast.explanationZh: 困難但穩定進展不是難有勝算的明確情境。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「難有勝算，就是永遠不能成功？」哪句最準確？

options.en: We may be fighting a losing battle with the current method, so let us change the conditions.
options.zh: 用現有方法可能難有勝算，所以我們改變條件吧。

options.en: Keep the current method unchanged and use the phrase to explain why no revision is worth trying.
options.zh: 保持目前方法不變，用片語解釋為何不值得嘗試修改。

options.en: Add more effort to the same approach before checking which conditions make success unlikely.
options.zh: 未查哪些條件令成功機會低，就在相同方法投入更多力氣。

dialogue.explanationZh: 難有勝算可針對目前方法與條件；應檢查及調整，而非把判斷當永久結果。

speaking.en: We are fighting a losing battle unless we deal with the source of the problem.
speaking.zh: 除非處理問題源頭，否則我們的努力難有勝算。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把困局連結到可改變條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們每天清理儲物室，但新物資沒有分類便不停送進來，雜物更多。用一至兩句英文描述目前困局，並建議先整理接收流程。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出目前源頭與處理速度的不相稱，提出改變流程；不要把困難寫成永遠無法改善。

examples.en: We are fighting a losing battle while unsorted supplies keep arriving. We should organise the intake first.
examples.zh: 未分類物資不停送來時，我們在難有勝算下苦撐。我們應先整理接收流程。

examples.en: Clearing the room is a losing battle unless we change the system. To stop fighting a losing battle, we need a clear sorting process.
examples.zh: 除非改變制度，清理房間難有勝算。要停止這種苦撐，我們需要清楚分類流程。

takeaways.en: We were fighting a losing battle until we changed the process.
takeaways.zh: 改變流程前，我們在難有勝算下苦撐。

takeaways.en: You may fight a losing battle if you ignore the cause and only clear the effects.
takeaways.zh: 忽略原因而只清理後果，努力可能難有勝算。

brief.meaningEn: Out of public view, often doing preparation or support work.
brief.meaningZh: 在公眾看不見的地方，通常做準備或支援工作。
brief.grammar: work/prepare/organise behind the scenes; not necessarily secret or improper.
brief.register: Common theatre-based idiom used beyond performance.
brief.boundaryZh: 幕後不等於不重要，也不一定故意保密；只是觀眾或公眾未直接看見。
brief.misconceptionZh: 沒有上台不表示沒有貢獻；也不能由未公開推斷有不當行為。
brief.outcomeZh: 能肯定公眾視野外的具體支援工作。

listening.en: While the students performed, technicians worked behind the scenes to keep the sound clear.
listening.zh: 學生表演時，技術人員在幕後工作，保持音響清楚。

options.en: They provided support away from the audience’s main view.
options.zh: 他們在觀眾主要視野以外提供支援。

options.en: They were visible on stage giving the main performance rather than supporting the sound.
options.zh: 他們在台上作主要演出，而不是支援音響。

options.en: They were preparing an unrelated future event rather than supporting the performance underway.
options.zh: 他們在準備另一項未來活動，而不是支援正在進行的表演。

options.en: They were the only people performing on stage.
options.zh: 他們是唯一在台上表演的人。

listening.explanationZh: 技術人員為正在進行的表演維持音響，屬幕後支援；不是台上主表演或準備不相關活動。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：你沒有上台，這次演出你負責甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What did you do for the performance if you were not on stage?

options.en: I checked the equipment and helped speakers prepare.
options.zh: 我檢查器材，幫講者準備。

options.en: I worked behind the scenes on the sound setup.
options.zh: 我在幕後處理音響設定。

options.en: I coordinated the schedule before each person went on.
options.zh: 每人上台前，我協調時間安排。

options.en: I helped solve practical problems during the event.
options.zh: 活動期間，我協助處理實際問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都描述具體支援；金句指出工作位置而非重要性低。

scene.promptZh: 展覽開幕時，義工在觀眾看不見的工作室整理備用資料，確保前台有足夠小冊子。哪句合適？

options.en: They worked behind the scenes to support the exhibition.
options.zh: 他們在幕後工作，支持展覽。

options.en: They stood at the front presenting the exhibition to visitors.
options.zh: 他們站在前台向訪客介紹展覽。

options.en: They were sorting material for a different event, with no connection to the exhibition’s leaflets.
options.zh: 他們在整理另一活動的資料，與展覽小冊子無關。

scene.explanationZh: 工作室整理資料是觀眾視線外的實際支援，確保前台有小冊子；不是前台介紹或另一活動資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 behind the scenes 得出？

options.en: Some activity happens outside the main public view.
options.zh: 部分活動在主要公眾視野外進行。

options.en: The work must be unimportant or dishonest.
options.zh: 工作必定不重要或不誠實。

options.en: Preparation can support a public event.
options.zh: 準備可支援公開活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 幕後只描述可見程度，不決定價值或道德。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「沒被觀眾看見，就不用感謝那些人吧？」哪句最合理？

options.en: People working behind the scenes can be essential, so we should acknowledge their contribution too.
options.zh: 幕後工作的人可能非常重要，所以也應肯定他們貢獻。

options.en: Allocate the thanks according to stage time before checking who prepared the event.
options.zh: 未查誰準備活動，就按台上時間分配感謝。

options.en: Thank the visible performers first and leave the unseen work out of the review.
options.zh: 先感謝台上表演者，檢討時略過觀眾看不到的工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 幕後工作也可很重要；應按實際作用肯定，不只按曝光。

speaking.en: Many volunteers worked behind the scenes to make the event run smoothly.
speaking.zh: 很多義工在幕後工作，令活動順利進行。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再肯定幕後貢獻。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校慶成功，大家只稱讚台上表演，但你知道有人在工作室核對名單、整理資料及處理音響。用一至兩句英文肯定這些人。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用具體支援工作說明幕後貢獻，不把沒被觀眾看見當作不重要或有秘密。

examples.en: Many helpers worked behind the scenes. Their careful preparation kept the programme running smoothly.
examples.zh: 很多幫手在幕後工作。他們仔細準備，令節目順利進行。

examples.en: We should thank the team behind the scenes for checking lists, preparing materials and managing the sound.
examples.zh: 我們應感謝幕後團隊核對名單、準備資料及管理音響。

takeaways.en: The team worked behind the scenes throughout the festival.
takeaways.zh: 整個節日期間，團隊都在幕後工作。

takeaways.en: We thanked the people behind the scenes as well as those on stage.
takeaways.zh: 我們既感謝台上的人，也感謝幕後的人。

brief.meaningEn: The law has effective enforcement powers or penalties, not just words on paper.
brief.meaningZh: 法律有有效執行權力或罰則，不只停留在紙上。
brief.grammar: the law has real teeth; teeth is a fixed plural metaphor for practical power.
brief.register: Neutral-to-informal legal commentary; examples here are hypothetical language tasks, not statements of current law.

sources.sentence: Conservation succeeds when the law has real teeth.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 21, table 2, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: In the hypothetical case, the law has real teeth because trained inspectors can enforce meaningful penalties.
listening.zh: 在這個假設個案中，法律有實際執行力，因為受訓巡查員能執行有實效的罰則。

options.en: There are practical enforcement powers and usable penalties.
options.zh: 有實際執行權力及可運用罰則。

options.en: The law exists only as an unenforced suggestion.
options.zh: 法律只是沒有執行的建議。

options.en: Every violation is guaranteed to be found.
options.zh: 每次違規都保證被發現。

options.en: Inspectors can offer advice but have no power to act on breaches.
options.zh: 巡查員只能給建議，沒有權力對違規採取行動。

listening.explanationZh: 受訓巡查員可執行有實效罰則，支持實際牙力；不只是建議，也不保證每次違規都被發現。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：這個假設制度為甚麼不只是紙上規則？
reply.promptEn: Why is this hypothetical system more than a rule on paper?

options.en: Inspectors have clear powers and resources to act.
options.zh: 巡查員有清楚權力及資源行動。

options.en: The law has real teeth because breaches can bring effective penalties.
options.zh: 法律有實際執行力，因為違反可帶來有效罰則。

options.en: The case includes a working process for investigating reports.
options.zh: 個案包含可運作的調查舉報流程。

options.en: The rules are supported by trained staff and enforceable consequences.
options.zh: 規則有受訓人員及可執行後果支持。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都說明假設制度的實際作用；金句不能只憑規則存在便用。

scene.promptZh: 課堂假設：規定附有清楚調查權、實際巡查資源及能執行的罰則。哪句有根據？

options.en: In this example, the law has real teeth.
options.zh: 在這個例子中，法律有實際執行力。

options.en: The rules have no practical way to be enforced.
options.zh: 規則沒有實際執行方法。

options.en: The example proves no future violation is possible.
options.zh: 例子證明未來不可能有違規。

scene.explanationZh: 執行資源及後果支持實效，但不保證違規消失。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 the law has real teeth？

options.en: Clear powers and resources allow penalties to be applied.
options.zh: 清楚權力及資源讓罰則可被執行。

brief.meaningEn: Take stronger action to stop illegal or unacceptable activity.

listening.en: In the classroom diagram, each species is a thread in the web of life, connected to others through feeding and habitat relationships.
listening.zh: 在課堂圖中，每個物種都是生命網絡中的一條線，透過食物及棲息地關係與其他物種連結。

options.en: Species are connected within a wider ecological system.
options.zh: 物種在更大的生態系統中互相連結。

options.en: Every species has exactly the same role.
options.zh: 每個物種角色完全相同。

options.en: The diagram predicts every future effect precisely.
options.zh: 圖示精確預測每個未來影響。

options.en: Each species has no relationship with any other.
options.zh: 每個物種與其他物種毫無關係。

listening.explanationZh: thread 與 web 的意象強調連結，不是相同角色或精確預言。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：為甚麼圖中不只看一種動物？
reply.promptEn: Why does the diagram show more than one kind of animal?

options.en: Its food and habitat connect it with other species.
options.zh: 牠的食物與棲息地令牠與其他物種連結。

options.en: It is a thread in the web of life, not an isolated object.
options.zh: 牠是生命網絡中的一條線，不是孤立物件。

options.en: The surrounding relationships help explain what it needs.
options.zh: 周圍關係有助解釋牠的需要。

options.en: We need to consider how the parts of the system interact.
options.zh: 我們需要考慮系統各部分怎樣互動。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都指出連結；金句以線和網形象描述，非實際纖維。

scene.promptZh: 課堂圖把動物、植物與食物關係連起來，想強調一個物種並非獨立存在。哪句合適？

options.en: Each species is a thread in the web of life.
options.zh: 每個物種都是生命網絡中的一條線。

options.en: Every species has exactly the same function.
options.zh: 每個物種功能完全相同。

options.en: Each species should be studied without considering its food or habitat relationships.
options.zh: 應研究每個物種，而不考慮其食物或棲息關係。

scene.explanationZh: 網中一線強調物種與其他生物有關係；不等於相同功能，也不是不看食物或棲息連結。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論最不宜由 a thread in the web of life 得出？

options.en: A species has relationships with other parts of its environment.
options.zh: 物種與環境其他部分有關係。

options.en: A wider system includes interacting elements.
options.zh: 更大的系統包含互動元素。

options.en: Every connection guarantees an identical and immediate effect.
options.zh: 每條連結都保證相同而即時的影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻不提供精確效果保證，需看實際關係。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「都是線，所以每種動物作用一樣吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Being a thread in the web of life means being connected, not having an identical role.
options.zh: 成為生命網絡中的一條線，表示有連結，不表示角色相同。

options.en: Give each species the same role in the diagram because each is called a thread.
options.zh: 因每種生物都稱作一條線，就在圖中給它們相同角色。

options.en: Separate the species into unconnected diagrams before examining their different relationships.
options.zh: 未檢視不同關係，就把生物分成互不相連的圖。

dialogue.explanationZh: 網中一線強調相連而非角色相同；不同角色仍可構成互相依存。

speaking.en: Every species is a thread in the web of life, with connections we need to understand.
speaking.zh: 每個物種都是生命網絡中的一條線，有我們需要理解的連結。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明比喻的連結意義。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：課堂案例畫出池塘動植物之間的食物及棲息關係。用一至兩句英文以線與網的比喻說明為何要看整個系統，而不只一種動物。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用比喻強調相互連結，並提實際關係，不說所有物種作用相同或每項影響都可預測。

examples.en: Each species is a thread in the web of life. We should study its connections with food, plants and habitat.
examples.zh: 每個物種都是生命網絡中的一條線。我們應研究其與食物、植物及棲息地的連結。

examples.en: The animal is a thread in the web of life, so understanding the wider system helps us understand its needs.
examples.zh: 動物是生命網絡中的一條線，所以理解更大系統有助了解牠的需要。

takeaways.en: A species is a thread in the web of life rather than an isolated object.
takeaways.zh: 物種是生命網絡中的一條線，而非孤立物件。

takeaways.en: Calling an animal a thread in the web of life highlights its connections.
takeaways.zh: 把動物比作生命網絡中的一條線，是凸顯牠的連結。

brief.meaningEn: Gradually, in small amounts or stages.
brief.meaningZh: 逐漸，以小量或小階段進行。
brief.grammar: verb + bit by bit; can describe improvement or deterioration.
brief.register: Common neutral expression.
brief.boundaryZh: 不一定每次一件物品，也不保證變化是正面；與全部立即完成不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 慢慢變化仍可以有實質成果，但片語本身不提供固定速度或日期。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述小量累積的過程，並區分逐個與逐漸。

listening.en: We restored the damaged model bit by bit, repairing one small section each evening.
listening.zh: 我們每晚修一小部分，一點一點修復受損模型。

options.en: Gradually through small stages over time.
options.zh: 隨時間以小階段逐漸進行。

options.en: Entirely in one instant with no stages.
options.zh: 沒有階段，瞬間全部完成。

options.en: At a fixed speed defined by the expression.
options.zh: 按片語指定的固定速度。

options.en: Without making any change at all.
options.zh: 完全沒有任何改變。

listening.explanationZh: 每晚小部分是逐漸的具體線索，沒有固定時間單位。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：這個大整理工作怎樣才開始得了？
reply.promptEn: How can we begin this huge sorting task?

options.en: We can start with one manageable area.
options.zh: 我們可先從一個能處理的範圍開始。

options.en: We can sort it bit by bit instead of trying to finish tonight.
options.zh: 我們可一點一點整理，而不是今晚全部完成。

options.en: A short regular session would make the task less overwhelming.
options.zh: 定期短時間處理會令工作沒那麼難應付。

options.en: We should keep track of the sections already finished.
options.zh: 我們應記錄已完成部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都提出可行方法；金句強調逐漸，而不是保證立即完成。

scene.promptZh: 你每天清理幾頁舊筆記，幾星期後整份資料變清楚。哪句最合適？

options.en: The notes became clearer bit by bit.
options.zh: 筆記一點一點變清楚。

options.en: Every page changed at exactly the same instant.
options.zh: 每頁在完全相同一刻改變。

options.en: The phrase proves the exact number of days needed.
options.zh: 片語證明所需的確切日數。

scene.explanationZh: 每天少量、幾星期累積是逐漸變化，不是同時或精確時長。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論最不符合 bit by bit？

options.en: A change happens through small amounts or stages.
options.zh: 改變透過小量或小階段發生。

options.en: The change must always be positive and successful.
options.zh: 改變永遠必須正面而成功。

options.en: The whole process need not happen at once.
options.zh: 整個過程不需一次完成。

contrast.explanationZh: 逐漸也可描述惡化，片語不決定好壞。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「一點一點太慢，沒有任何意義吧？」哪句最有建設性？

options.en: Working bit by bit can still produce a useful result if we keep a clear goal.
options.zh: 只要保留清楚目標，一點一點做仍可帶來有用成果。

options.en: Judge the whole effort by the first small stage before allowing time for the rest.
options.zh: 未給其餘階段時間，就按最初小部分評價整體努力。

options.en: Keep completing small stages but postpone checking whether they support the main goal.
options.zh: 繼續完成小階段，較後才查它們是否配合主要目標。

dialogue.explanationZh: 逐步可累積成果，仍需明確目標及檢查；不宜只看第一步，也不宜延後核對方向。

speaking.en: We improved the guide bit by bit after each round of feedback.
speaking.zh: 每輪回饋後，我們一點一點改善指南。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述分階段改進。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你想修復一個舊模型，計劃每晚處理小部分，而不是一次做完。用一至兩句英文描述方法與記錄進度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 表達逐漸小階段與整體目標，無需捏造完成日期，也不把片語當成功保證。

examples.en: I will repair the model bit by bit, working on a small section each evening. I can record my progress.
examples.zh: 我會每晚處理小部分，一點一點修復模型，也可記錄進度。

examples.en: The model can improve bit by bit if I check each repair and keep a clear plan.
examples.zh: 只要我檢查每次修復並保留清楚計劃，模型可一點一點改善。

takeaways.en: The room became more organised bit by bit.
takeaways.zh: 房間一點一點變得更有條理。

takeaways.en: The old surface wore away bit by bit over the years.
takeaways.zh: 多年來，舊表面一點一點磨損。

brief.meaningEn: Combine or accumulate to create a significant total effect.
brief.meaningZh: 多項小事結合或累積，形成顯著整體影響。
brief.grammar: small actions add up; add up to + result; added up in the past.
brief.register: Common neutral phrasal verb; here cumulative effects rather than arithmetic or plausibility.
brief.boundaryZh: 影響可好可壞，不必立刻看見；本課不是故事合理與否的 that does not add up。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一件事小不表示累積也小，但不能不看持續時間或數量便保證結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述小行動的累積效果，並區分其他 add up 用法。

listening.en: The small improvements added up to a much clearer guide after several rounds of revision.
listening.zh: 幾輪修改後，小改善累積成一份清楚得多的指南。

options.en: They combined into a significant overall improvement.
options.zh: 它們結合成顯著的整體改善。

options.en: Each change had to produce the whole result alone.
options.zh: 每項改動都必須獨自產生全部結果。

options.en: The guide’s story was judged impossible to believe.
options.zh: 指南的故事被判斷為不可信。

options.en: The sentence gives an exact arithmetic total.
options.zh: 句子給出確切算術總和。

listening.explanationZh: 多輪小改動形成整體效果，不是每項獨立完成全部，也非另一種合理性用法。

reply.promptZh: 朋友問：每次只改一點點，真的有用嗎？
reply.promptEn: Can changing only a little at a time really help?

options.en: Several small improvements can work together.
options.zh: 幾項小改善可互相配合。

options.en: They can add up to a much better experience over time.
options.zh: 它們可隨時間累積成好得多的體驗。

options.en: We should compare the overall result after a few rounds.
options.zh: 我們應幾輪後比較整體結果。

options.en: A clearer label and a simpler step can both help the user.
options.zh: 較清楚標籤與較簡單步驟都可幫使用者。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都說明小變化的價值；金句以可能性描述累積。

scene.promptZh: 每天幾分鐘整理筆記，幾週後找資料省了很多時間。哪句合適？

options.en: The small daily efforts added up to a useful improvement.
options.zh: 每天的小努力累積成有用改善。

options.en: The improvement came from one complete reorganisation on the final day, not the daily sorting.
options.zh: 改善來自最後一天一次全面重整，而非每天整理。

options.en: A new filing tool alone produced the result, while the regular sorting had no role described.
options.zh: 結果只來自新分類工具，沒有描述定期整理的作用。

scene.explanationZh: 題目把幾週後省時連到每天少量整理，是累積效果；沒有提一次重整或新工具作唯一原因。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句的 add up 是「看來合理」，而非本課累積效果？

options.en: The small delays add up over a whole week.
options.zh: 小延誤在整星期中累積。

options.en: His explanation does not add up because the dates contradict each other.
options.zh: 日期互相矛盾，所以他的解釋說不通。

options.en: The small changes added up to a better service.
options.zh: 小改動累積成較好服務。

contrast.explanationZh: 解釋因日期矛盾而 does not add up，是評價是否合理；小延誤或改動則有多項因素累積的意思。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「每次只拖兩分鐘，永遠不會有影響吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Small delays can add up across many tasks, so let us check the total effect.
options.zh: 小延誤可以在很多任務中累積，所以我們看看整體影響。

options.en: Assess each delay separately and leave the repeated minutes out of the total.
options.zh: 分開評估每次延誤，不把反覆分鐘計入總數。

options.en: Count only useful time savings when deciding what can add up.
options.zh: 判斷甚麼會累積時，只計有利的省時。

dialogue.explanationZh: 小延誤也可能累積成不利影響；應看總數，不限於正面成果。

speaking.en: Small improvements can add up to a better overall experience.
speaking.zh: 小改善可以累積成較好的整體體驗。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把小改動與整體影響連結。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們每週改善一個學會報名流程的小問題，幾週後新生更容易完成報名。用一至兩句英文描述累積效果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把多項小改善連到累積結果，不要求每項單獨產生全部效果，也不要與解釋說不通的另一用法混淆。

examples.en: The small changes added up to a clearer registration process. New students can now complete it more easily.
examples.zh: 小改動累積成更清楚報名流程。新生現在較容易完成。

examples.en: Better labels and simpler steps can add up over time, so we should keep checking the overall experience.
examples.zh: 較好標籤與較簡單步驟可以隨時間累積，所以我們應持續檢查整體體驗。

takeaways.en: Small daily choices can add up to a meaningful change.
takeaways.zh: 每天的小選擇可以累積成有意義改變。

takeaways.en: Repeated delays added up and made the whole task take longer.
takeaways.zh: 反覆延誤累積，令整項工作花更長時間。
